## Match longread assemblies with paper2
```{r}
library(data.table)
```

```{r}
tm3_samples <- fread("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/10_metadata/tm3_metadata_with_ibdpainting_all_samples.txt")
assemblies <- fread("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/007_allele_specific_expression/pacbio_longread_genomes/Athaliana_assemblies_paper2.txt")
## Keep only 1 TAIR10
assemblies <-assemblies[assemblies$Assembly_ID!="100002",]
```
## Get accessions which intersetc
```{r}
library(data.table)
# Make sure both join columns have the same data type
tm3_samples[, Accession := as.character(Accession)]
assemblies[, Accession_ID := as.character(Accession_ID)]

# Keep only rows where Accession overlaps with Accession_ID
result <- merge(
  tm3_samples,
  assemblies[, .(Accession_ID, Assembly_ID)],
  by.x = "Accession",
  by.y = "Accession_ID"
)

str(unique(result$Accession))
##Number of assemblies
str(unique(result$Assembly_ID))
```
## Are they any accessions with >=1 accession ID? 
```{r}
result[, .(n_assembly_ids = uniqueN(Assembly_ID)), by = Accession][n_assembly_ids > 1]
```
## Write the output
```{r}
write.table(result,"/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/007_allele_specific_expression/pacbio_longread_genomes/intersection_with_tm3_data.csv", quote = F, row.names = F, sep="\t")
assembly_ids <- unique(result$Assembly_ID)
write.table(assembly_ids,"/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/007_allele_specific_expression/pacbio_longread_genomes/unique_longread_assemblies.csv", quote = F, row.names = F, sep="\t")
```
